notes.title: Changes to the Free Scenario Cycle & Other Improvements
notes.content:
Great news, everyone: we have decided to [b]change the free scenario cycle from 1 week to 2 and 1/2 hours[/b]! Plus the Story of Fathers & Sons scenario is now back on the free rotation. Enjoy!

[h1]Patch notes[/h1]

Changes:
- Fathers and Sons is back in free rotation!
- Free rotation changed from 7 days to 2.5 hours!
- Shauna's dress is all pink again
- Minor UI improvements here and there
- Minor story text improvements here and there
- Fathers and Sons has more booze and you can drink alone without toasting

Fixes:
- Fix to settings file problem: http://steamcommunity.com/app/307290/discussions/0/617328415054868574/
- Sea of Fire cutscene spam reduced
- Fathers and Sons cutscene spam reduced
- Fathers and Sons quest, action and story logic bug fixes

notes.title: Subscription No Longer Required & Announcing DLCs!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we have now finished the process of introducing the much requested scenario-based pricing. This means a subscription is no longer required for Velvet Sundown all-access. You can now either purchase your favorite scenarios separately or buy the whole bundle for a reduced price. We have also created a party pack including 5 keys for the price of 4 - a perfect gift for your friends!

Velvet Sundown stays free-to-play: each week one of the scenarios is available for free of charge.

For our existing and previous premium customers: current subscriptions are now terminated and as a thank you for the support we will be sending you free Steam keys to the Velvet Sundown bundle very soon!
 
Special DLC Launch Discount:
Get 20% off for a limited time only! Valid for both seperate scenario DLCs and bundles.

[h1]Velvet Sundown Editions[/h1]

[b]Invidual Scenario DLCs[/b]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/327200/]Sea of Fire[/url] 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/349330/]Murder![/url] 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/349331/]Story of Fathers and Sons[/url] 

[b]Bundles[/b]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/60664/]Velvet Sundown Original Bundle[/url] (includes all 3 scenarios)
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/sub/60862/]Originals Bundle Five Pack[/url]  (includes 5x the Original Bundle for sharing with friends)

notes.title: Fixes to Murder! Scenario
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

first of all we'd like to apologize for the lack of updates to the game recently due to our limited resources. After watching Forsenlol playing Velvet Sundown on Twitch last night, we noticed an issue with the logbook on the Murder! scenario. We have now fixed this and added a few other improvements to the game. Thanks again for all the support, there have been many awesome streams and videos of Velvet Sundown!

Wishing everyone a Happy New Year,
Velvet Sundown team

Patch notes for build 13883:
[list]
 [*] Murder! - The logbook description now has a list of characters who haven't accused anyone yet.
 [*]Added a mouse target text for characters and other clickable objects.
 [*]When leaving the conversation mode, the camera is moved behind the character.

notes.title: New Scenario "Murder!" Now Available for Everyone
notes.content:
[h1]Brand new scenario [b]Murder![/b] has been rolled out and it's available for everyone as the free scenario of the week![/h1] 
[b]Murder![/b] is a classical mystery setting where someone has been killed and it’s up to the group to draw the conclusions while the murderer tries to avoid being caught. There's a maximum of 5 players per game for this scenario.

As always, we'd love to hear your feedback, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts and suggestions either here on the Steam Community forums or on our own Community Forums at http://community.velvetsundown.com/ !

[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-h-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xpf1/t1.0-9/10419022_688414984575037_4941400257242218807_n.png[/img]
